luiskr.com / website/components/media/figure/load / loadHighRes

function loadHighRes(fig): Promise<void>

Defined in: website/components/media/figure/load.ts:93

Thumb → high-res swap. A detached Image preloads the Q50 variant — webp first, jpg on 404 (the "if webp exists" check is the request itself, no manifest round-trip); on load the visible element swaps src

  • gets the loaded class (the CSS crossfade) and the thumb hides. The 4096²-pixel budget gates the GPU texture upload only — oversized sources still fetch and decode (the browser owns that memory), so a big file can never pin its card on the blurred thumb. Errors mark loaded anyway — a broken image must not pin the skeleton shimmer forever.

fig

MediaFigure
